sa.training_fitness.text: The staff went through the squad's fitness: {n_kader} players in the squad, {ausfall}. {spielsatz} Decide how hard to train until then.
sa.presse_saisonziel.titel: Press asks about the season target
sa.presse_saisonziel.text: Journalists want to know where {verein} is heading this season. The board expects place {ziel}. A clear statement before the first match shapes the coverage of the coming weeks.
sa.presse_ausblick.titel: The press looks ahead to the season
sa.presse_ausblick.text: The papers size up {verein} before the start: {n_kader} players in the squad, average age {alter} years. They ask whether this mix will carry the season.
sa.vorstand_erwartung.text: For {verein} the board sets place {ziel} in the table as the yardstick. Your work this season is measured against it, and trust at the club depends on it.
sa.vorstand_budget.titel: Board reminds you of the transfer budget
sa.vorstand_budget.text: The board of {verein} points out that {budget} is available for reinforcements. More room only comes from selling players.
sa.berater_kaderplanung.titel: Squad planning: a gap in the squad
sa.berater_kaderplanung.text: The sporting director has counted the squad. {luecke} Time for a signing, a loan or a player from the youth side.
sa.berater_kader_ok.text: The sporting director has counted the squad: {n_kader} players, average age {alter} years, enough players in every part of the team. Signings are not a must, just fine-tuning.
sa.spieler_rolle.text: {ref_rolle} wants to know before the start of the season which role is planned in the squad. There are {n_pos} players in this part of the team, and not all of them play. A clear word now prevents unrest later.
sa.spieler_vertrag.titel: Agent gets in touch about the contract
sa.spieler_vertrag.text: The agent of {ref_vertrag} gets in touch: the contract only runs for {monate} more months. He wants to know early whether the club wants to extend before others come knocking.
sa.transfer_geruecht.text: The media speculate about {ref_top}. At {gehalt_top} a year this is the best-paid player in the squad, and exactly such players get clubs with big budgets talking. There is no offer.
sa.transfer_fenster.text: The transfer window is still open for {fenster_rest} days, {budget} is ready for reinforcements. Anyone who wants to act now should check the watch list.
sa.medizin_check.titel: Medical check at the start of the season
sa.medizin_check.text: The team doctor has gone through the squad. Current state: {ausfall}. As soon as that changes, he will get in touch.
sa.scouting_gegner.text: The next opponent is {gegner}, kick-off {wann}, {ort}. The scouts have put the material ready. Look at the opponent analysis before you set the line-up.
sa.jugend_blick.titel: Youth head: talents in the squad
sa.jugend_blick.text: The youth head points out that {jung_da} young players are in the squad. They need playing time if they are to develop. Pre-season is the chance for that.
sa.fans_spieltag.titel: Supporters look forward to the match against {gegner}
sa.fans_spieltag.text: The supporters are preparing for the match against {gegner}: kick-off {wann}, {ort}. They plan trips and displays and expect a team that fights.
sa.kabine_mischung.text: {n_jung} young and {n_alt} experienced players meet in the dressing room, {n_kader} in total. The older ones set the tone, the young ones want to show themselves. Both sides should feel heard.
sa.abend_bilanz.text: {n_heute} messages came in today, {n_offen} of them still wait for you. What stays open you will see again tomorrow morning.
sa.abend_vorschau.text: {spielsatz} The assistant coach recommends rethinking the line-up this evening and keeping an eye on the players' workload.
sa.abend_stab.text: The coaching staff sums up the day: {n_kader} players in the squad, {ausfall}. Tomorrow's session takes place as planned unless another absence comes up.
